Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.channels

Interface LightningChannelGateway

All Known Implementing Classes:
DisabledLightningChannelGateway, LndRestLightningClient
public interface LightningChannelGateway
Structural Lightning channel operations (open / close / policy / inventory). Separate from payment/invoice gateways (ISP).

  • Method Details

    • isLive

      boolean isLive()
      Returns:
      true only when the configured Lightning provider is reachable and enabled

    • providerName

      String providerName()
      Returns:
      stable provider name used in diagnostics and persisted execution metadata

    • listChannels

      List<LightningChannelGateway.ChannelSnapshot> listChannels()
      Returns:
      current open/active channel inventory; an empty list means no channels were returned

    • observeChannels

      default LightningChannelGateway.ChannelInventory observeChannels()
      Strict inventory for capital decisions; unsupported/failed observations must throw.

    • listPendingChannels

      default List<LightningChannelGateway.PendingChannelSnapshot> listPendingChannels()
      Pending open / pending force-close / waiting-close channels (LND PendingChannels). Default empty — adapters that omit pending inventory must not claim double-open safety.

    • newOnchainAddress

      default String newOnchainAddress(String label)
      Fresh on-chain address in the LND wallet, used to bind a CHANNELS mesh withdraw target to a specific open decision. Default unsupported.

    • confirmedOnchainBalanceSats

      default long confirmedOnchainBalanceSats()
      Confirmed LND wallet (on-chain) balance in sats, or -1 when unknown.

    • openChannel

      LightningChannelGateway.OpenChannelResult openChannel(LightningChannelGateway.OpenChannelCommand command)
      Requests opening a channel using the provider and waits for its immediate response.
      Parameters:
      command - peer, local capacity, and channel visibility/confirmation options
      Returns:
      provider funding transaction, channel outpoint, and raw response snapshot

    • closeChannel

      LightningChannelGateway.CloseChannelResult closeChannel(LightningChannelGateway.CloseChannelCommand command)
      Requests cooperative or force closure of an existing channel.
      Parameters:
      command - channel outpoint and whether closure must be forced
      Returns:
      closing transaction identifier and provider response snapshot

    • updateChannelPolicy

      LightningChannelGateway.UpdatePolicyResult updateChannelPolicy(LightningChannelGateway.UpdatePolicyCommand command)
      Updates fee and forwarding policy for an existing channel.
      Parameters:
      command - channel outpoint and requested fee/timelock values
      Returns:
      whether the provider accepted the update and its raw response snapshot

      Optional circular rebalance via self-payment. Default: unsupported.
